commands.command:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-app.service > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory web application
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-app/app.py
Restart=always
User=nobody

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now inventory-app
sleep 1
sudo systemctl is-active inventory-app
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/inventory

sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-app.service > /dev/null <<'EOF'
